datasets.product: USGS Landsat 8/9 Collection 2 Level-2 surface reflectance
datasets.version: Collection 2 Tier 1; scene processing revisions in asset names
datasets.spatialSupport: 30 m native pixels; field-edge mixing and geolocation uncertainty remain

qa.method: Native pixel/field intersection areas; reject fill/cloud/shadow/snow/water/saturation/high or climatology aerosol; allow low/medium interpolated aerosol with its fraction exposed

limitations: Most accepted pixels use spatially interpolated low/medium aerosol estimates; observation records expose that fraction.
Seasonal observations have QA gaps; neither isolated low indices nor repeated low indices establish bare soil, residue protection or continuous exposure.
NDVI/BSI cannot reliably distinguish residue from bare soil without local labels.
Scene cloud percentage is discovery metadata; field QA is applied independently.

datasets.product: USDA NRCS SSURGO via Soil Data Access
datasets.version: Live SDA snapshot; component surveyVersionDate retained
datasets.spatialSupport: Mapped soil units containing component mixtures, not measured subfield soil
datasets.units: awc_r: cm/cm; integrated AWC: mm per 0–100 cm

qa.method: Clip actual survey polygons; depth-integrate complete nonoverlapping horizons; component and area weighting; missing values not imputed

datasets.spatialSupport: 1 arc-second native postings (~31 m north–south, ~23 m east–west here), not validated field microtopography

qa.method: Actual native file CRS, spacing, packing and nodata checked; area intersections in EPSG:32615
qa.sourceClassMask: NUM and SWB layers not provided by this mirror; source composition uncertainty unresolved

limitations: Primarily February 2000 SRTM with ancillary void filling; surface heights can include vegetation/buildings.
No calibrated slope erosion, drainage routing, or frost-pocket inference.
Native source-class and water masks unavailable in this public mirror.

datasets.version: 061 verified from captured CSV granule IDs; matching JSON encoded arrays
datasets.spatialSupport: Native nominal 250 m sinusoidal grid (231.656358264 m postings). Full 9 × 9 cell neighborhood (~2.085 × 2.085 km), not the 44 ha field. No resampling.
datasets.units: NDVI/EVI dimensionless; encoded scale 0.0001, offset 0, fill -3000; QA unscaled; composite pixel day-of-year 1–366, fill -1

qa.method: Pixel reliability 0; MODLAND 0; usefulness 0–2; low/intermediate aerosol; land only; no adjacent/mixed cloud, snow or shadow; valid VI and selected day within composite period. No gap filling.

bandMetadata.description: Relative azimuth angle of VI pixel
Sun zenith angle of VI pixel
View zenith angle of VI Pixel

limitations: A composite selects different observation days at different pixels; its start date is not a simultaneous overpass or a 16-day mean.
Mixed land covers and coarse support: regional seasonal context only, never used to fill Landsat gaps or confirm a field condition.
Conservative QA can withhold an entire regional mean. No calibrated uncertainty, bare-soil classification or agronomic benefit inference.
Only composites fully inside the requested season are included; edge days remain unsupported.
